title: Bear Den TV per-site navigation hints
description: Data that tunes the navigation script (apps/web-nav) for one web adapter: which elements to prefer or skip, where the player is, how Back and the media keys behave. Hints ship inside the binary (apps/web-nav/hints/<adapter>.json); they never come from phones or config. The script must work without them (the generic behaviour).

id.description: The web adapter the hints belong to.

verified.description: false until the hints were checked on the real site; every shipped file is false (UNVERIFIED).

prefer.description: Extra elements that are focus targets (poster cards the generic scan might miss).

initial.description: Where focus starts on a page, first visible match wins.

modal.description: Overlays that trap focus, besides [role=dialog], [aria-modal=true] and dialog[open].

close.description: Close buttons inside an overlay, tried before the generic ones.

player.description: The player container that receives the media keys.

back.description: The Back sequence, first step that applies wins. Default: field, fullscreen, overlay, history.

media.description: The site's documented keyboard shortcuts. Seeking is always by keys, never by setting currentTime.

key.description: The closed set of keys the coordinator will press for a page (internal/applications/web AllowedKeys).
